semantic_projection: Read only explicit unique typed status/value JSON fields; additional fields may make strict format false while semantic fields remain correct. No prose or gold-assisted repair.
strict_format: Exactly status,value plus optional unique string-list evidence_ids; finite bounded JSON,duplicate keys rejected; integer answers exclude booleans and floats.
operational_error: Any non-null explicit error field denotes a failed operational observation; it is never semantic success or abstention. Missing and failed cases remain scheduled denominators.

metrics.semantic_accuracy: explicit status/value correctness independent of extra-field formatting
metrics.strict_accuracy: semantic correctness AND strict output format
metrics.answerable_accuracy: SUPPORTED positive-value tasks only, same named scope as original scorer
metrics.calibration: UNMEASURED without a separate qualified probability instrument
metrics.evidence_reference_truth: UNMEASURED by this scorer; external provenance verification required

atlas_rows.native_metadata: Explicit study,recipe,family,positive integer depth,train_draw/order/eval_family/initialization seeds,code commit and checkpoint/data/scorer/qualification/measurement receipt hashes
atlas_rows.dose: unique_parents<=presentations;updates<=presentations;supervised<=processed;positive presentations need parent/input exposure;supervised adaptation updates need target exposure
atlas_rows.metric_unit: Core metric estimates and interval95 endpoints are proportions in[0,1],with interval containing estimate; efficiency gain is a proportion difference in[-1,1]
atlas_rows.unmeasured: Metrics remain null; unmeasured rows cannot establish numeric efficiency
atlas_rows.measurement_association: Native numeric efficiency requires actual receipt bytes matching measurement_receipt_sha256 and all declared row/dose/gain fields; byte association is NOT proof of execution or qualification
atlas_rows.measurement_envelope: schema_version2,kind CRS_LA_MEASUREMENT,payload with row excluding measurement_receipt_sha256 and explicit gain

paired_intervals.identity: Unique case_id globally and variant_id within parent; reject duplicates and family drift
paired_intervals.membership: expected_cases mapping must match every scheduled case and parent/variant/family identity for future native integration; absent binding is openly descriptive only
paired_intervals.sampling: Whole parent mean vectors within family strata; repeated variants are not independent samples
paired_intervals.uncertainty_scope: Conditional on supplied families/draws; few clusters warning; no untouched confirmation,noninferiority or promotion certificate

retention.membership: Fixed per-skill item IDs and strict semantic success booleans
retention.missing_incumbent: UNAVAILABLE; loss/denominator/retention fields stay null,never silently replaced with source
retention.identity_attestation: Actual source/incumbent/checkpoint identities belong to external immutable run receipts

future_runner_integration: Separate reviewed successor; original runner/scorers/results untouched
missing_learning_instruments: exact512+64 prompt/target token streams and masks
approval: Versioned CPU instrument only; no fabricated gain,retention,calibration,frontier or mechanism
